whoWeAre.title: Navrachna Foundation for Entrepreneurship Development
paragraphs: Navrachna Foundation for Entrepreneurship Development, a subsidiary of "I.T.S. Engineering College", is a platform to assist and enable young entrepreneurs to initiate the commercial exploitation of technologies developed by them.

It also enables budding entrepreneurs to showcase and test their abilities to run a start-up business. The center provides a range of resources that empower students, faculty & staff to pursue entrepreneurial achievements to improve people's lives, drive the economy & help innovators bridge the gap between inventors and venture capitalists.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: To create an innovative workspace that nurtures entrepreneurs, fosters creativity, and accelerates startup success.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: To provide a dynamic and collaborative workspace that empowers entrepreneurs with resources, mentorship, and networking opportunities.

leadership.title: Chairman's Message
leadership.message: I am delighted to know that I.T.S Engineering College, Greater Noida has come up with its own startup policy. I am happy that institute has formulated a start-up policy that aims to propel the engineering and management students of I.T.S Engineering College, to contributes to the nation's socio-economic progress through promotion of technology-driven students start-up. Students have lot of potential to do wonders and have big dreams while studying in the campus. In fact many students wish to start his own venture and looking himself as boss but they fails due to lack of pre-entrepreneurial knowledge, guidance and eco-systems. I hope successful implementation of this startup policy will create many world renowned CEOs from I.T.S Engineering College Campus.

offers.title: Co-working Spaces
offers.desc: Premium co-working hot desks and private offices designed for high-focus, collaborative startup work.

offers.title: Mentorship Programs
offers.desc: Dedicated domain mentors — seasoned industry professionals and academic experts guiding your startup journey.

offers.title: Fabrication & Electronics Labs
offers.desc: Hands-on access to electronics testing labs, 3D printers, fabrication workspaces, and high-end computing systems.

offers.title: Seed Funding Access
offers.desc: Financial support through government schemes — DST NewGen IEDC grants, MSME-BI, and StartinUP UP state incentives.

offers.title: Networking Opportunities
offers.desc: Bridge the gap between innovators and venture capitalists through structured networking events and investor connects.

offers.title: IP & Patent Support
offers.desc: Guidance and funding for domestic and international patent filing to protect your proprietary innovations and inventions.
